title: LTX Reference to Video: a single portrait picture reaches the graph unfilled and gets black padding
description: Found by MPI-1096 (2026-10-13). routes/ingredientsSheet.js buildReferenceSheet returns png null for ONE picture (it 'IS the sheet, sent as it is'), so the raw file reaches ImageResizeKJv2 #903 in comfy_workflows/ltx_i2v_t2v*.json, which fits it to the clip with BLACK padding. A portrait picture on a landscape clip (or the reverse) becomes a mostly-black guide. In the MPI-1096 bench a mostly-black guide (portrait beach 736x1308 fitted to 960x512, used as its own IC guide) produced an ALL-BLACK clip on seed 1, and the composer's own rule says big black areas make the clip copy the sheet layout (docs/models/ltx/reference-ingredients.md, sheet composer table). Job: first reproduce in the shipped single-guide path (one portrait picture, landscape clip, 2 seeds, local bench under gpu_lease) - unproven there; if it reproduces, fill the single picture like the multi-picture sheet does (grey card, or a centre crop for a setting) in buildReferenceSheet, both engines get it since the composer runs before upload. Evidence: .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-1096/research/shortlist.md (search 'black').
